title: Canonical constant pullback component with module coefficients
statement:
Variables and instances are those of the attached Lean module.

theorem ordinaryFiniteConstantPullback_hom (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (constantSinglePullbackIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f (ModuleCat.of A A)).hom =
      (singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).hom.app
          (ordinaryFiniteConstant A Y) ≫
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map
          ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).hom.app
            (ModuleCat.of A A))

proof.text: Specialize constantSinglePullbackIso_hom to the module coefficient category and the coefficient module A. The same single-degree comparison and the same constant-sheaf comparison are the two factors. This proved specialization caches the structural instance conversion before comparing the ordinary factorization.
